entry_points.text: Duplication delivers an independent descriptor preserving bounds, ownership and content references with fresh sync and linkage, or reports exhaustion without partial objects. Discard validation forbids special and usually locked areas with hugetlb alignment, handling empties and dispatching after revalidation and clamping.

exports.text: VMA helpers rename via a merge descriptor, recompute cached protection with writenotify handling for lock-free readers, discard mappings with batched shootdown, withdraw frames with distinct outcomes, and detach folios via huge, movable or reclaim paths.

hazards.text: Overflow diagnostics only warn and offer no recovery, so callers cannot rely on truncation. Bound or count mismatch warns once with dumps, escalating to fatal fault on count divergence; debug builds add range warnings on store-window misalignment.

Split addresses must lie strictly inside, driver hooks may veto, and descriptor, policy, anon, file and reservation steps can fail without partial publication. Splitting dissolves straddling huge state with hugetlb handling and validates after publication. Pre-mutation exhaustion leaves mappings unchanged with reservation as the commit boundary.

Scanners yield after spans, reestablish mappings, bound batches before rescheduling checks, and abort on fatal signals. Concurrent activity can repopulate guard intervals needing invalidation and retry. Hole punching needs a file reference across the lock drop. Failed split, isolation or migration must return busy without poisoning and restore partial lists.

invariants.text: Fault-free helpers return zero on success, ERANGE for denied kernel sources and EFAULT on faults, always restoring fault state. Kernel width adapts to alignment, user ranges validate up front with NMI check on reads, copies never sleep, strings terminate with truncation accounting.

Anon names are heap allocated, reference counted, cleared on null, ignored when equal, otherwise adopted with old release; builds without naming reject non-null with EINVAL. Area updates skip matching flags and names, else reshape, refresh the cursor, enter write protection, store flags and apply naming.

Modification reuses a satisfying encompassing mapping, else isolates the interval, reporting ENOMEM on exhaustion and sticky bits on coalescing. Split admission precedes mutation. File and anon offsets move together, page span scales byte span, iterator last is inclusive, and unfaulted private anon mappings align offset unless exempt.

Merging needs equal policy, flags ignoring a set, same file, compatible context, equal name and exclusive ownership. Cloning into empty needs neither side fork-shared; fork-shared means non-singular chain and refuses concentrating merges. Sides need abutting bounds with contiguous offsets, anon contiguity only for file cow, compatible neighbours both-side, no close hooks on removed areas, and outer non-special edges for existing edits. Cloning is a no-op without active objects, else one chain per entry with partial discard; fork may adopt quiescent objects, others bump counts with shared verification. Policy assigns only on success; tracking shares with guard or succeeds trivially.

Willneed branches by backing: anon prefetches swapped pages via walks, shmem scans cache ignoring present and non-swap markers, direct-access files succeed trivially, other files hold a reference across a lock drop around the filesystem hint and reacquire. Anon prefetch skips non-swapped under lock and fetches swapped async.

Cold and pageout share a scanner rejecting locked, special or hugetlb areas, skipping shared or unevictable folios, handling whole large folios and splitting partial ones only when exclusive and lockable, clearing history then deactivating or reclaiming under read walk locks with TLB sessions. Free applies only to anon, releases swap runs, splits partial large folios when exclusive, and marks lazily free after invalidation.

A fixed subset is discarding. With sealing, unsealed areas accept all, sealed areas accept non-discarding and file-backed discarding, sealed anon discarding only when writable, else denied; without sealing checks succeed. Dispatch enforces permission then routes handlers or flag updates, with sequential and random exclusive and fork, dump and naming restrictions.

Guards reject special or huge areas and locked areas except for removal. Install marks maybe-guarded atomically with caller walk mode, prepares anon state, places markers with invalidation on populated or huge encounters and bounded retries. Existing markers count as done. Removal clears leaf markers with cache care, skipping huge upper entries and accepting locked areas.

Populate prefaults in chunks, reacquiring the lock if dropped and mapping failures to interruption, invalid, poisoned, fault or shortage. Remove applies only to file-backed shared writable unlocked mappings, holds a file reference across the drop, notifies userfault and punches a hole preserving size before relocking. Injection needs admin and steps by compound size, soft-offlining or simulating failure.

Soft offlining validates the frame, requires online pages, honors a global switch, treats poisoned as success, then under a mutex grabs the page, applies a veto filter, and migrates in-use pages or poisons free or huge pages with one retry. In-use targets split only at zero order, wait for writeback under folio locking, evict clean file content or isolate and migrate, reporting busy on failure.

Teardown detaches areas matching the torn-down context under the write lock; flag updates need it. Attach replaces the context, clears prior bits before merging, and refreshes protection on shared write-protect changes. Protection derives with a writenotify variant for lock-free readers. Remove notification skips without context or interest, else counts, drops the lock, publishes and awaits killable completion.

locks.text: Cloning needs exclusive space write protection; allocation precedes tree membership without anon locking, linkage runs under exclusive anon protection. Detach removes under exclusive anon protection with a second lock-free pass destroying emptied objects. File edits use mapping write protection with cache care and probe notices; anon edits use anon write protection, publishing mappings before counts.
Duplication needs exclusive writers and advisory handling honors caller-declared none, space read, space write or area read without reacquiring.

state_machines.text: Initializer establishes merging state with defaults and checksums, ensures slab caches, starts the scan thread, publishes controls or selects a merge default without sysfs, and subscribes to hot-remove where supported. Slab failure ends before thread creation, thread failure after slab cleanup, interface failure after thread stop plus slab cleanup.

Mutation follows prepare, boundary adjustment and complete: prepare detaches views and reserves linkage, adjustment moves bounds, complete publishes views, stores separated areas and retires removed ones including a second area when coalescing. Merging starts in no-merge; reservation and commit move to success, while resource failure restores position, releases cloned ownership and reports no-memory or abandons silently.

structs.text: Walk context exposes TLB with pageout; interval exposes start with end; behavior descriptor exposes space, behavior, TLB, lock mode, anon name, range, previous and current areas and drop flag. Lock choices are none, space read, space write and area read. Areas expose flags, cached protection, userfault slot, file, start, owner and anon state.

Each chain binds one area to one anon object with dedicated alloc and release. Duplication preserves owner, ops, bounds, anon ownership, offsets, file, protections, flags and policy with empty tracking. Prep captures target, ownerships and neighbour disposition; merge descriptors carry refs with span, offsets, policy and flags; guard walks carry callbacks with lock selector and counter.

Anon-naming selector is negative one, guard retry bound is three, and on wide builds anon offset stores as paired halves while narrow keeps the low half. Advice covers normal, random, sequential, fork, dump, free, dontneed, remove, guard, willneed, cold, pageout, collapse, mergeable, huge, populate and soft offline. Reports span interruption, invalid, poisoned, fault, retryable shortage, access, permission, busy, io, offline and unsupported. Area bits span locked, special, hugetlb, shared, write, sealed, pattern, fork, dump, droppable, userfault, guard and maybe-guarded; removal keeps size, injection needs admin, offlining uses counted, soft, action and simulated flags.
